Sections, stable-first: (1) THE MAP — the richest areas at steering grain; (2) AREA INDEX — every other area, named, one line each; (3) ACTIVE SURFACE — recent + load-bearing witnesses; (4) FOCUS — material loaded for your focus, LAST. The map and index never vary with your focus; your per-call material is at the end.

^-marked entries are compressed stubs carrying child addresses. Their narration and any surfaced witness quotes are verbatim-accurate — quote them as-is — but a stub carries no provenance (source, date, supersession). Expand (aswritten_expand with the IRIs you need) before any claim that turns on WHEN or by WHOM something was said, or whether it is still the current framing. Witness-depth sections below already carry full provenance.

Deciding where to go: each mapped area's narration tells you the SPAN of what lives under it; the area index names everything else. Expand a subtree when its narration (or name) shows your subject plausibly lives there — you'll get the trajectory, the variants, and the verbatim witness. But be strict about absence: if neither the map's narrations nor the index's names substantively cover your subject, it is NOT in this perspective — say so rather than expanding a loose thematic match (a word-overlap is not coverage). Decide from the map; expand to ground.

positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsRetainedAsset
positions.frame: what separates the intelligence you own and keep from the intelligence you merely rent or draw from a commodity substrate?
positions.why: Both expressions are calm, plain-spoken, aphoristic maxims (register, affect) that partition value along the same axis — src-2 opposes owned to rented intelligence, src-3 opposes commodity substrate to kept asset. Relational and power reads both land on market-pricing logic and rational-persuasion-with-inspirational-appeal rather than authority or hierarchy; value reads both as appeals to autonomy and self-enhancement through possession. Conviction differs in register — src-2 reads as a claim, src-3 as a principle — but both are asserted flatly, unhedged, as the same underlying distinction restated at two levels (capability vs. asset), so the tension between claim-level and principle-level delivery sits inside one coherent directional read rather than splitting it.

standalone.why: Pass 2 marked this segment unreferenced — it never resolved to any referent (no candidate binding was even attempted), so there is no subset to reconcile it against. It stands as a self-contained positioning note and lands as fresh witnessed commentary.

Pass 2 verdict 'new': no witness-depth match, no area-index entry to expand into, so there is no existing node for this to reconcile against despite it reaching for prior positioning. Nothing to bind — it lands as fresh witnessed commentary, available for a later conclusion to bind to.

placements.why: src-2 and src-3 draw a differentiation line (owned vs rented, commodity vs kept asset) that is positioning-grade, not product-mechanics or architecture content. No strata exist yet in this repo; the shape of this content — a retained-value thesis meant to orient how the offering is understood against alternatives — is squarely organizational-strategy grain, so it needs a home at that tier rather than folding into a bare leaf with no parent.
placements.title: Where the org names its market differentiation and positioning thesis
placements.frame: Does this content stake out how the org's offering is positioned against a substitutable alternative, rather than describing what the offering does or how it's built?
consulted: focus section — no witness-depth match, confirming nothing existing already covers this positioning thesis

placements.title: Owned perspective outlasts rented substrate
placements.frame: Does this expression draw the line between capability you own and keep versus capability you merely rent from a commodity substrate?
placements.why: src-2 states the owned/rented distinction directly as a thesis-level claim; src-3 restates it one register further as a constitutive principle (substrate as commodity, perspective as the kept asset). Both are plain-spoken aphoristic maxims (register/affect), market-pricing relational logic, and value reads that ground in autonomy/self-enhancement through possession rather than a rented substitute — the same directional axis at two levels of delivery, matching the position pass's own grouping of these two segments under one position. This names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (the owned-vs-rented distinction as recurring positioning), not a one-time fact, so it clears the narrative grain test rather than being folded into a fact-level support line.
